statements.text: When a new order is linked into the order book's doubly-linked list, the previous tail order must point forward to the new order and the new order must point backward to the previous tail order in storage.
evidence: - The previous tail order properly points forward to the new order
- The new order fails to point backward to the previous tail order in storage

statements.text: The linked list must remain traversable in both directions, so reverse traversal from tail to head must work.
evidence: - The linked list becomes partially one-directional
- Traversal from head to tail works, but reverse traversal fails

statements.text: Removing an order must not cause permanent loss of preceding orders or incorrect head order reassignment in the limit price struct.
evidence: Removing an order with missing prev reference causes:
- Incorrect head order reassignment in the limit price struct
- Permanent loss of preceding orders
